endpoints.description: 🎮 Get Item Information for a Specific Game
details: Retrieves all possible item names for a specific game.
Supports filtering by item types, groups, and individual items.
Provides comprehensive information about items in a game.
Supports both cached and real-time data retrieval (configurable with `no_cache`).
Compatible with popular Steam games like CS2, Dota 2, and Rust.
usage_notes: Use the `game` parameter to specify the game.
Optionally, filter by `type` to refine the results (e.g., groups, items, types).
Set `no_cache` to `1` to fetch real-time data, bypassing the cache.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Short name of the game.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type of the requested list. Accepted values: - groups: Item groups. - items: Individual items. - types: Item types. - structed: Structured data (default)

parameters.name: no_cache
parameters.description: Disable caching by setting to 1. Default is cached data.

responses.description: Request was successful, and item information is returned.
Rate limit exceeded. Too many requests in a short time frame.

endpoints.description: 🔄 Convert a SteamID into Multiple Formats
details: Converts a SteamID into different formats: SteamID2, SteamID3, SteamID64.
Returns the result as JSON.
Supports all major SteamID formats for conversion.
Simple and efficient conversion for fast integration.
usage_notes: Provide a valid `steam_id` in any format (`SteamID2`, `SteamID3`, or `SteamID64`).
Use your API key to authenticate the request.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: steam_id
parameters.description: The SteamID to convert. Accepted formats: - SteamID2: e.g., STEAM_0:0:553498XXX. - SteamID3: e.g., [U:1:1106997XXX]. - SteamID64: e.g., 76561199067263XXX.

responses.description: Request was successful, and the converted SteamID formats are returned.

endpoints.description: 🎯 Retrieve All CS2/CS:GO Containers and Collections
details: Retrieves all containers and their collections from CS2/CS:GO.
Provides a comprehensive list of cases, stickers, and other containers.
Supports filtering by container type (`all`, `sticker`, `case`).
Enables searching for specific cases using the `search` parameter.
Results can be sorted by name, price, or release date.
usage_notes: Use the `type` parameter to specify the group of containers to fetch.
Optionally, apply the `search` and `sortBy` parameters to refine your results.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Show only this group of containers. Accepted values: all, sticker, case.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search for a specific case or container by name.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort the result by a specific criterion. Options: - nameAz: Name ascending. - nameZa: Name descending. - priceSteamAz: Steam price ascending. - priceSteamZa: Steam price descending. - priceRealAz: Real market price ascending. - priceRealZa: Real market price descending. - releasedatAz: Release date ascending. - releasedatZa: Release date descending.

responses.description: Request was successful, and all containers are returned.

endpoints.description: 🎯 Retrieve a CS2/CS:GO Collection or Case
details: Retrieves a list of all collections and their items (skins) from CS2/CS:GO.
Provides detailed information about a specific collection or case.
Fetches all items (skins) belonging to a specific collection or case.
Supports both CS2 and CS:GO collections.
usage_notes: Replace `{slug}` with the collection's unique identifier to fetch the desired data.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The unique identifier (slug) of the collection or case.

responses.description: Request was successful, and the collection data is returned.
The specified collection or case was not found.

details: Retrieves a list of all supported markets.
Provides information including: Market logos, Market names, Relevant market data.
Comprehensive data on supported markets for integration and analysis.
Up-to-date market details with structured responses.
usage_notes: Use your API key to authenticate the request and access the data.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

responses.description: Request was successful, and market information is returned.
Rate limit exceeded. Too many requests in a short time frame.

endpoints.description: 🔍 Auto-Complete Game Items - e.g for using on Input fields (for free)
details: Provides real-time auto-completion for game items with search suggestions based on the input.
Retrieves a list of items matching the search term, ideal for input auto-completes.
Returns the name and image URL of each item.
Instantly retrieve search suggestions (minimum 3 characters).
Supports filtering by game.
Includes item image URL for visual preview.
usage_notes: API key is optional for now but recommended for production/future compatibility.
Currently free, future cost: 1 request credit per 100 queries.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication (optional but recommended for production use).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: The search term for auto-completion. Must be at least 3 characters long.

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Short name of the game (e.g., "cs2", "dota2", "rust").

endpoints.description: 💱 List All Available Currencies for Conversion
details: Retrieves a list of all available currencies for conversion.
The default base currency is USD (United States Dollar).
The data source is Steam by default but can be customized.
Supports specifying a custom base currency using the `base` parameter.
Allows changing the data source via the `source` parameter.
usage_notes: Use the `base` parameter to specify the currency code for conversion (e.g., `EUR`, `TRY`).
Optionally, set the `source` parameter to customize the data source.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: The base currency code for conversion. If not specified, USD is used as the default.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Specifies the source of the currency data.

parameters.name: production
parameters.description: If you run in production, please set this to 1. Default is 0. This is in future required, and if not set, you will get a warning.

responses.description: Request was successful, and the list of currencies is returned.

details: Provides the exchange rate for a specified currency.
Allows specifying the currency to convert to (`change` parameter) and the base currency (`base` parameter, default: USD).
Fetches accurate exchange rates.
Supports all major currency codes based on the ISO 4217 standard.
usage_notes: Use the `change` parameter to specify the target currency (e.g., `EUR`, `TRY`, `RUB`).
Optionally, use the `base` parameter to specify the base currency (default is `USD`).

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: change
parameters.description: The target currency code to exchange to. Supported values follow the ISO 4217 standard (e.g., EUR, TRY, RUB).

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: The base currency for the exchange. Supported values follow the ISO 4217 standard.

responses.description: Request was successful, and the exchange rate is returned.
